source_refs: tutorial 4d84a9a0-94f9-57e2-a8e6-333ba26d72e4: starting with the lowest equation; substituting the result into the next-lowest equation; continuing until all variables have been found
features: All supplied as three upper-triangular equations with unit leading entries.
